frame_note: frame numbers are dataset frame indices; t_s counts from frame 100
frame_of_reference: odom: east north up metres, map frame minus origin_map
detections: dataset annotations with noise (labels plus noise), not a trained detector; sigma 0.3 m, size 0.2 m, yaw 3 deg, class_prob 0.9, at least 5 own lidar points, within 100 m
ego_view: GodView snapshot_ego of vehicle 1 per frame; status solid when vehicle 1 itself contributes (its own sensor is among contributing_agents), ghost when only other agents do

points.static_odom.npy: N x 3 float32, every 5th frame of all four lidars, points outside label boxes, voxel 0.2 m
points.moving_odom.npz: per frame key (6 digit frame) M x 3 float32, points inside label boxes (+0.15 m) of all four lidars, voxel 0.08 m

settings: selected tracker, self reports, single per source, ego view, offset filter off, no anchors, no injected pose error
